name: When should I repair my shower versus replacing the entire unit?

mainEntity.name: When should I repair my shower versus replacing the entire unit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between repairing and replacing your shower depends on the extent of the damage, the age of the unit, and your budget. If the issue is isolated, such as a leaky faucet or a clogged drain, repair is usually the most cost-effective solution. However, if there are multiple recurring problems, significant structural damage, or if the unit is very old, replacement might be a better long-term investment. Our technicians can assess the condition and provide options to help you make an informed decision based on the specific issues observed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair minor, isolated issues; consider replacement for extensive damage, frequent problems, or very old units. We help assess and advise.
